Do you carry trays full of cocktails more balanced than a gymnastic on the balance beam? We're on the lookout for hospitable servers for Stadscafe. 
 Job description 
As a Service Employee, you are at the very heart of our restaurant. You work across breakfast, lunch, and dinner service, serving dishes, creating a warm atmosphere, and ensuring guests have an unforgettable experience - often before they even ask. No two days are the same, as you effortlessly switch between different moments of the day in a dynamic and lively environment. 
You're an all-rounder: you work according to established procedures, while keeping your approach personal and genuinely hospitable. At the same time, you make sure every table experience is spot on - from start to finish. You introduce guests to high-quality products and fine wines, and have a natural feel for what each guest needs. 
Stadscafe stands for good food, great drinks and a pure and genuine atmosphere. A place for anything from early birds with their newspaper and coffee in the morning, to the lovebirds on a datenight with a cocktail at the bar. Our restaurant is located in the heart of Westerpark, in a historic building right next to the Conscious Hotel Westerpark. Whether hotel guests come in for breakfast, locals drop by for drinks, or someone is looking for a relaxed moment, you make sure they feel immediately welcome and at home. Job requirements 
About you: - 
You are looking for a fun part-time job and are flexible, including weekends; - 
Strong focus on communication and hospitality; - 
Enjoys working in a dynamic hospitality environment; - 
At least 1 year of experience in a similar role; - 
Fluent in Dutch and English; - 
A true love for good food. 
Join the Fun & Perks: -

Looking for that full-time job with training and growing opportunities? Work only in the day shift? Look no further! You found your  new job as a warehouse employee at Xenos in Waalwijk!
Sign up now and receive a WhatsApp message within 15 minutes with a few short questions so we can help you quickly. Don't have a WhatsApp? Then we'll contact you by phone or email!

What we offer
- Work in only day shifts
- Full-time work
- Salary of €14,99 per hour
- A friendly and cosy working atmosphere!
- Reimbursement of travel expenses
- Work in different departments

Who you are
To keep the warehouse running, it is important that you meet the following requirements as a warehouse employee:

- You have your own transport to go to Waalwijk.
- You speak Dutch or English.
- You can work in day shifts.
- You are available at least 2 days during the week.

What will you do
Sofas, chairs, confetti cannons, candles, cushions... Xenos has it all! As a warehouse employee, you’ll work among all this fun, colorful stuff. You work at the department for all of the products for the Xenos stores. You’re going to be driving around on an EPT to get all the different products! You put everything where it needs to go. You don’t need any prior experience, we’ll teach you everything!
This job is for the dayshifts only. You'll work from 07:00h until 16:00h. Awesome, right?!
Xenos pays different wages per age:

- 18 jaar: €7,50/hour
- 19 jaar: €8,99/hour
- 20 jaar: €11,99/hour
- 21+ jaar: €14,99/hour

Where will you work
You have probably already seen the Xenos stores! They are located all throughout the country! You will recognize Xenos by their fun, yellow logo 💛. Xenos has great products for your home. You will often see them in the warehouse! You will also get a great discount at the Xenos stores!
As a warehouse employee you will have great colleagues. You take breaks together and you are well supported by the team leaders. You’ll definitely feel welcome here!

Ready to kickstart your workday in a dynamic environment? As a warehouse worker, you play a crucial role in the logistics process. You will be working at a client of ours in Hoofddorp, the absolute specialist in exotic products. This is a stable position where you can truly build for the long term!

You start the day with a fresh cup of coffee, have a quick, to-the-point check-in with your team leader, and dive straight into the warehouse. From collecting orders on the EPT to getting freight ready for transport: you stay physically active, keep an overview, and work together with your team to supply stores and customers on time.

Tasks:
 - Order picking exotic products in various storage locations efficiently and safely.
 - Operating an EPT to move goods quickly and safely through the warehouse.
 - Moving freight and stock to loading docks, storage areas, and delivery vehicles.
 - Stacking and packing goods neatly for safe shipment.
 - Keeping the work environment clean, organized, and safe.
 - Working closely with your team and coordinating with connected stores.
 - Working longer hours on busy days whenever you want to.

What we are looking for:
 - A true doer who is physically in great shape and loves to roll up their sleeves.
 - An EPT certificate is required (don't have one yet? We will arrange it for you!).
 - You are looking for stability and a long-term commitment.
 - Available for the fixed working hours from 06:00 to 15:00.
 - Willing to work two Saturdays per month from 06:00 to 11:00.
 - Ability to stay organized and perform well under pressure during peak times.
 - Good communication skills in Dutch or English to understand work instructions.
 - Living in or near Hoofddorp, such as Amsterdam, Aalsmeer, Haarlem, or Nieuw-Vennep.

What we offer:
 - An attractive salary that perfectly matches your effort and experience.

With a gross hourly wage of €15.55, good employment conditions, and plenty of opportunities to grow, this is your moment! Read the vacancy quickly and don’t forget to apply. Employment agency Manpower is looking for logistics employees for a company based in Eemshaven.

Experience is not required, making this a great opportunity to start a career in logistics.

What's in it for you

    - Gross salary of €15.55 per hour
    
- Travel allowance of €0.25 per kilometer, up to 30 kilometers
    
- Full-time job of 37.5 hours per week
    
- Chance of a temporary contract with the prospect of permanent employment
    
- Free development opportunities through the Manpower Academy with over 200 online courses
    
- Working in a clean and safe warehouse following 5S principles
    
- Opportunity to develop and grow within a large, sustainable organization

    - Minimum of MBO level or equivalent
    
- Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG)
    
- Willingness to work full time
    
- Accuracy and a proactive attitude
    
- VCA is a plus, but not mandatory

As a Cleanroom Operator, you play an important role in maintaining the quality of high-tech products used in industries such as semiconductors and electronics. You will work in a controlled cleanroom environment where accuracy, safety, and quality are essential.

Your daily tasks include:

- Cleaning high-tech components according to cleanroom procedures and work instructions.
- Performing assembly work using hand tools and technical drawings.
- Inspecting products and carrying out quality measurements.
- Preparing and cleaning metal frames and packaging materials according to protocol.
- Reporting deviations and registering quality findings in the production system.
- Reading and following technical drawings and work instructions accurately.
- Keeping your workplace clean, safe, and organized according to cleanroom standards.

Working hours

You will work from Monday to Friday in a 2-shift schedule:

- Morning shift: 06:00 – 15:00
- Evening shift: 15:00 – 00:00

You will receive an 18% shift allowance for working in shifts. Overtime on Saturdays or Sundays is paid at 150% when applicable.

Required

- Good command of the English language.
- Ability to read technical drawings and work instructions.
- Technical insight or experience within a production environment.
- Willingness to work in a 2-shift schedule.
- Living in or within travelling distance of Eindhoven, Helmond, Veldhoven, or Valkenswaard.

Preferred

- Experience working in a cleanroom environment.
- Experience with assembly work or high-tech production.

jobs.occupation: Part-time order picker AS Watson in Heteren (113823003)
jobs.description:
As a part-time order picker at AS Watson, you play an important role in supplying well-known stores like Kruidvat, Trekpleister, and ICI Paris XL. You work at the distribution center in Heteren, where a headset tells you exactly which products to pick and where to place them. You handle both small and larger products, walk a lot, and keep your fitness up at the same time. You can choose your own shifts: morning (06:00–14:00), afternoon (14:00–22:00), or night (22:00–06:00, for 3-shift schedule). Prefer to work weekends only? That's possible too! Apply today and we'll discuss the options with you. 

- You speak Dutch or English
- You are available at least 16 hours per week
- Available at least one Saturday every 4 weeks. 
- You are fit enough to walk a lot
- You live a maximum of 30 km from Heteren
- You want to work in shifts

Do you enjoy working with your hands and with different materials?

Composite material is made up of multiple materials bonded or laminated together. Think panels, interior parts, and structural aircraft components. As a Composite Shop Worker, you'll repair and maintain these parts. You're comfortable working with a range of materials: composite, plastic, metal, and interior materials. You carry out repairs according to fixed technical specifications and work instructions, working precisely with professional tools in a hangar or workshop environment. You'll also identify and resolve damage to interior and composite components, a role that combines the best of sheet metal work and interior work.

- You have experience working with different materials, or a relevant technical education (e.g. in sheet metal work, composites, or interior construction)
- You have a precise, careful way of working
- You're willing to (further) build your technical expertise
- You speak good English (technical drawings are all in English)
- You're comfortable working with computers; administration is also part of the job
- You're willing to occasionally work evenings and weekends (on average once every 4 weeks - after 8 months from starting)
- Experience in car body repair, automotive interiors, or manufacturing work involving composite/plastic materials is a plus
